beats.text: The villain is an imbalanced ratio, where growing model capacity without increasing token count traps weights in a permanent, underfit state.
beats.visual_focus: A bottleneck graphic representing the ratio between Parameters and Tokens.

beats.text: Empirical analysis of four hundred training runs reveals the geometry: compute-optimality requires scaling tokens and parameters in perfect tandem.
